title: Towers before the raid
goal: Three Grunts will raid your Peasants in about two and a half minutes; you have two Footmen. Get towers up in time: a Guard Tower needs a Lumber Mill, so build the Lumber Mill at once, then two Scout Towers between the Gold Mine and the Town Hall (build #peasant Scout Tower near the gold mine), and upgrade each to a Guard Tower as soon as the mill stands (upgrade #tower Guard Tower). Keep the other Peasants mining. When the raid comes, cast Call to Arms at the Town Hall and fight under the towers.
